description: This file defines the UserAgentMiddleware class for AWS SDK for PHP, which constructs and injects user agent headers into HTTP requests. It includes methods for building user agent values based on SDK version, environment, and configuration, and handles middleware invocation for request modification.

classes.name: UserAgentMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class responsible for creating and injecting the User-Agent header into AWS SDK HTTP requests, including SDK version, environment details, and optional metrics.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method that returns a middleware handler function wrapping an integer handler with specific arguments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with a handler callback and optional arguments.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to add the User-Agent header to the request using the next handler.

methods.name: requestWithUserAgentHeader
methods.description: Builds the user agent string and injects it into the HTTP request headers.

methods.name: buildUserAgentValue
methods.description: Constructs an array of user agent components by invoking various internal methods.

methods.name: getUserAgentVersion
methods.description: Returns the user agent version string based on the agent version constant.

methods.name: getOsName
methods.description: Returns the OS name and version.

methods.name: getExecEnv
methods.description: Returns the AWS execution environment variable if set.

methods.name: getEndpointDiscovery
methods.description: Returns endpoint discovery info if enabled in arguments.

methods.name: getAppId
methods.description: Returns application ID info if set.

methods.name: appendEndpointMetric
methods.description: Appends endpoint override metric if endpoint override is provided.

methods.name: appendAccountIdModeMetric
methods.description: Appends account ID mode metric based on configuration.

methods.name: appendRetryConfigMetric
methods.description: Appends retry mode metric based on retries configuration.
